note: St. Martin Parish assessor parcels are published only through the GeoPower viewer (atlas.geoportalmaps.com/stmartin), an HTML parcel query app with no public ArcGIS REST or file endpoint found. The OpenAddresses source (services.geoportalmaps.com/arcgis/rest/services/StMartin_Services/MapServer/8) returns 404. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for St. Martin parcels found only boundary layers (ALOP parish lines, LADOTD parish boundaries). Commercial vendors (Dynamo, Equator, Acres) are paid, not official.
